say:1:1720944001:1.male: Detective! We've got our opening! This is our chance, and we may never get another one like it!
say:1:1720944001:1.female: Detective! We've got our opening! This is our chance, and we may never get another one like it!

choice_prompt:2:1720944001.text: Detective! We've got our opening! This is our chance, and we may never get another one like it!
choice_prompt:2:1720944001.source_cn: 侦探<male>先生</male><female>小姐</female>！大消息！绝对是千载难逢的好机会！
choice_prompt:2:1720944001.male: Detective! We've got our opening! This is our chance, and we may never get another one like it!
choice_prompt:2:1720944001.female: Detective! We've got our opening! This is our chance, and we may never get another one like it!

say:3:1720944002:1.text: We've had Viscount Demit's manor under watch all day. Just now, we saw him leave with the whole family in tow!
say:3:1720944002:1.source_cn: 我们一直盯着德米特子爵的府邸，就在刚才，我们亲眼看到，...

say:4:1720944003:1.text: And that's not even the best part! We asked around, the butler's off visiting family, and the servants have been given the rest of the day off!
say:4:1720944003:1.source_cn: 没错！而且我们打听过了，他家的管家今天请假去探亲，仆人...

say:5:1720944004:1.text: Which means the manor's basically empty. If we're going in, now's our chance!
say:5:1720944004:1.source_cn: 也就是说——现在他家空无一人！这是我们潜入调查的绝佳时机啊！
say:5:1720944004:1.male: Which means the manor's basically empty. If we're going in, now's our chance!
say:5:1720944004:1.female: Which means the manor's basically empty. If we're going in, now's our chance!

say:6:1720944005:1.text: Exactly. We can't let this chance pass us by!
say:6:1720944005:1.source_cn: 是的！机不可失，时不再来！

choice_prompt:7:1720944005.text: Exactly. We can't let this chance pass us by!
choice_prompt:7:1720944005.source_cn: 是的！机不可失，时不再来！

say:8:1720944006:1.text: Yes! Our first real sneaking mission!
say:8:1720944006:1.source_cn: 好耶！执行第一次潜入调查计划！

choice:7:0:1.text: Then what are we standing around for? Let's move.
choice:7:0:1.male: Then what are we standing around for? Let's move.
choice:7:0:1.female: Then what are we standing around for? Let's move.
